_what: CURATED per-arm blind inputs for the DeepTernary head-to-head. Picked from the RCSB-sourced candidates in selcal-deepternary-controls.json -- never from memory.
_blindness_rule: Only the native ternary POSE stays sealed. Public 'target binds warhead-class ligand' and 'VHL binds anchor-class ligand' binaries are legitimate inputs (deepternary-qualification-protocol sec 3) -- they carry no information about how the two proteins sit against each other, which is the thing being predicted.
_none_of_these_are_in_the_exclusion_set: the sourcing query excluded all 4,471 disclosed ids. Binaries would not appear there anyway -- TernaryDB holds two-protein complexes -- so this is a weak guarantee and is stated as one.

poi_binary.why: same CCD series and deposition year as the degrader (A1BB5 vs A1BB4) -- the closest available warhead-class frame

e3_binary.why: VHL with a 517 Da VH032-class ligand -- an anchor frame of the right chemotype

poi_binary.why: the ONLY SMARCA4 bromodomain binary with a drug-like ligand in the sourced set; chemotype is UNRELATED to the degrader's warhead and 9 years older

e3_binary.why: VHL with a 517 Da VH032-class ligand -- an anchor frame of the right chemotype

\u26a0_asymmetry_between_the_arms: THE TWO ARMS ARE NOT EQUALLY WELL SUPPLIED, and that has to be visible before any number is read. SMARCA2 has a contemporaneous binary from the SAME CCD series as the degrader (A1BB5 vs the degrader's A1BB4, both deposited 2024), so its warhead frame is defined by a near-identical chemotype. SMARCA4 has NO such binary -- the best available is an unrelated chemotype from 2015. A worse SMARCA4 prediction would therefore be partly an input-quality artifact, not necessarily a property of the generator, and the arms are NOT comparable to each other. The comparison that IS valid is each arm against OUR OWN co-fold on that same arm, which is the head-to-head this was built for.
_open_before_running: Ligand IDENTITY is taken from the RCSB record's name/MW, not verified as a substructure of PRT3789. The prep step must confirm the picked ligand actually overlaps the degrader's corresponding fragment, and REFUSE rather than proceed if it does not.
Per-arm chain ids for each binary are not yet resolved; deepternary_blind_prep is config-driven and needs them.
